# libreac / fuzz_disco

libreac's own fuzz target `fuzz_disco` ([source](source/fuzz_disco.c), unmodified), which OSS-Fuzz does not run, over libreac 1.9.0 (FreeREAC/libreac at d16f3f4e).

Reads the payload as our MAC, a setup byte and up to 512 operations on a clock the input moves back and forth: classify a frame (each in its own allocation) and pass it through the announce gate into the discovery table, offer it to the hunt, or age the table, serialise it as JSON into a buffer of an input-chosen size and step the hunt.

## How this program differs from a libFuzzer build of this fuzz target
- Linked against a static libreac.a of every src/*.c of libreac 1.9.0 at commit d16f3f4e, compiled with each build's flags, as libreac's Makefile builds its fuzz targets but with this toolchain in place of a native clang and libFuzzer.
- In every build, getenv() returns NULL, getpid() returns 1 and mkstemp() uses a fixed name, so the program depends only on its input.
- A small driver reads the input file, calls the fuzz target one to four times and prints each return value.

## What the harness checks
- A sighting comes from a frame of at least 50 bytes, is the frame's own source and never our MAC, its geometry is the frame length's (at least that, for the hunt), its role is in range, outside FILLER its block checksum closes, and a declared width is at most REAC_MAX_CHANNELS ([lines 181-237](source/fuzz_disco.c#L181-L237)): abort(); not confirmed in the binary.
- The gate, the table and the hunt's table never hold more than REAC_DISCO_MAX peers or the same MAC twice, and every table role is in range ([lines 106-158](source/fuzz_disco.c#L106-L158)): abort(); not confirmed in the binary.
- An observe reports 0 or 1, the table's seq moves by that report plus one on the first refusal for room, and an entry the table holds as a box never becomes a master ([lines 251-276](source/fuzz_disco.c#L251-L276)): abort(); not confirmed in the binary.
- An observe changes the table as the harness calculates: a known entry takes each fact that sharpens it and the new time, reporting a change exactly when a fact changed; a new MAC gets an entry with the sighting's facts; a full table refuses a new MAC and marks itself overflowed ([lines 277-356](source/fuzz_disco.c#L277-L356)): abort(); not confirmed in the binary.
- Ageing removes exactly the entries a forward clock shows unheard for longer than the stale limit (none when the clock stepped back) and moves the table's seq on by one exactly when it removed some; a hunt step reports 0 or 1 and every verdict has a name ([lines 703-735](source/fuzz_disco.c#L703-L735)): abort(); not confirmed in the binary.
- Classify, the gate and the hunt's observe answer only their documented values, and the hunt never reports as a master a peer its table holds as a box ([lines 749-784](source/fuzz_disco.c#L749-L784)): abort(); not confirmed in the binary.
- A table always serialises into a buffer of REAC_DISCO_JSON_MAX bytes, and a successful serialisation is one NUL-terminated JSON array of the length returned with one object per entry, holding that entry's MAC, role, model, width, owned flag and age in ms ([lines 556-648](source/fuzz_disco.c#L556-L648)): abort(); not confirmed in the binary.

## Builds
Static riscv64 Linux programs, compiled for RV64G and run as `<file> <input-file>`; `oft fetch libreac` downloads the published ones and checks each against its SHA-256.

| build | file | bytes | sha256 |
|---|---|---:|---|
| plain | `fuzz_disco.plain` | 58,944 | `04988e3ab31341965e44f0ca1bb0e5ed18fe6892e2c753df7a87bec197576f7c` |
| ubsan | `fuzz_disco.ubsan` | 60,920 | `56121de6ba4cff85e0fa262e9783f384e35fb8642d057f7a3a4290bcc245b22e` |
| asan | `fuzz_disco.asan` | 602,136 | `5e39150dd8104df969eb360f9cc29c4f92fe12326afd23783a679e4fb4809f46` |
| asan-ubsan | `fuzz_disco.asan-ubsan` | 603,064 | `cee6f04ad3d4928e242405689ae058bb9e8b6533000c90bde984a2f0d5ff5146` |

Each build also links code that no sanitizer instruments, as its link recorded it. A statement about a sanitizer build covers that code only as uninstrumented code: ASan checks no load or store made inside it, and UBSan inserts no check there.

- plain: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc.a` (the C library)
- ubsan: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc.a` (the C library)
- asan: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.asan.a` (the sanitizer runtime), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc.a` (the C library), `libunwind.a` (the C++ runtime)
- asan-ubsan: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.asan.a` (the sanitizer runtime), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc.a` (the C library), `libunwind.a` (the C++ runtime)
